name: Old-Style Brochure
description: A tri-fold letterpress brochure aesthetic — kraft paper, ruled dividers, seals, ledgers and torn edges — carrying live org feed, RSVP/calendar, directory, video and audio embeds. Two page compositions share one section library: an org profile (org-profile) and a single-offering promo page (offering).

sections.label: Masthead ribbon
sections.notes: Sticky ribbon-shaped bar: crest mark, org name, in-page nav, and a join/RSVP CTA.

sections.label: Broadsheet hero
sections.notes: Masthead-style headline framed by double rules with a torn lower edge. Works for either an org name or a single offering's title.

sections.label: Mission cartouche
sections.notes: Ornamental-corner panel with a drop-cap opening. 'Who we are' on the org page, 'about this offering' on the product page.

sections.label: Services medallions
sections.notes: Summarized services as circular seal badges in a grid. Org-profile use; skip on single-offering pages.

sections.label: Ledger of particulars
sections.notes: Dotted-leader fact rows. Org-profile: impact figures. Offering: price/date/format/capacity — retitle the rows in the editor.

sections.label: Torn-edge gallery
sections.notes: Rotated, deckle-edged photo frames. Drop to a single frame for one piece of art on an offering page.

sections.label: Video & audio panel
sections.notes: The embed spot for video (speaker-grille framed iframe) and music (gramophone-disc framed <audio>). Swap the iframe src and audio source in the editor.

sections.label: Dispatches (feed)
sections.notes: Live org-feed embed styled as newspaper columns with a single featured 'blog post' above the grid (data-limit=1). The embed spot for feed and blog post.

sections.label: Almanac (calendar / RSVP)
sections.notes: Live countdown + RSVP embeds housed in torn calendar-page cards. The embed spot for calendar.

sections.label: Roster / directory
sections.notes: Live directory embed, themed as a committee/roster list. Org-profile use.

sections.label: Wax-seal quote
sections.notes: Single pull-quote beside a stamped wax-seal ornament.

sections.label: Ticket-stub CTA
sections.notes: Ticket-shaped band, perforated between an info half and an inquiry-embed stub half.

sections.label: Back-panel footer
sections.notes: Dashed fold-line footer with three columns and a small repeated crest.
